stem:
Jhanvi tries to hold her breath during a PE warm-up. After a short time she has to breathe again.

Which statement best explains why holding the breath soon becomes difficult?

options.text: The air she breathes in supplies oxygen her body needs, so she cannot go long without a fresh supply.
She needs nitrogen from the air more than anything else, and that is why breath-holding fails quickly.
Her body stops all functions the instant she starts holding her breath.
With enough oxygen stored once, a person can survive indefinitely without food or water as well.

teacher.key_rationale: Breathing supplies oxygen the body needs. Holding the breath cuts that supply.
